t: What he said when he repaid a loan
a: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي أَهْلِكَ وَمَالِكَ إِنَّمَا جَزَاءُ السَّلَفِ الْحَمْدُ وَالأَدَاءُ
p: Bāraka-Llāhu laka fī ahlika wa mālik. Innamā jazāʾu-s-salafi-l-ḥamdu wa-l-adāʾ
m: May Allah bless you in your family and your wealth. The repayment of a loan is thanks and settlement.
